answer: To spawn a sybil, an attacker must fund a fresh terrace of staked identities, each paying the full bond plus escalating registration fees, so costs scale linearly with fake accounts while honest single-identity participants pay once. Each agent must stake a bond at a reef-anchored registry, and every epoch it earns reputation by completing verifiable tasks whose proofs chain from a unique identity vertex. From Agent0071's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
